messages:
mira: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region retry spike. Summary: TLS handshake tail + aggressive client retries causes conntrack pressure -> route churn. Need owners, short timelines, and an automated detection query.

leo: I'll own routing debounce and prefix-cache sanity check. Plan: 200ms default debounce on route-update path, emit metrics (route.debounce.count, route.debounce.ms). Target: 2026-04-05 EOD.

zane: I'll take conntrack mitigation. Immediate action: bump table size + GC threshold and run canary 5%->50%->100% today. Follow-up capacity test w/ k6 long-tail profile next week. Hotfix ETA: today.

priya: I'll own TLS fallback path and canary. Add fallback to TLS1.2 for specific TLS1.3 negotiation failures + alert when fallback >0.1%. Will coordinate cert rotation test. Target: 2026-04-04.

ops_oncall: Excerpts from logs during the spike:
```
[2026-04-03T22:34:12Z] LB tls: handshake timeout client=10.21.5.9
[2026-04-03T22:34:12Z] conntrack: insert failed: table full id=112358
[2026-04-03T22:34:13Z] route: rapid updates service=edge-api region=us-west-2
```
Many short-lived connections, SDK retry backoff truncated in some older clients. Added pcap playbook link and tagged nodes.

mira: ops_oncall please add scheduled query to detect cross-region retry spikes (10m window grouped by origin->dest) and post a weekly digest to #incidents-weekly. Also add an annotation on the postmortem with metric thresholds.

ops_oncall: Added scheduled query `cross_region.retry_spike` every 15m and digest -> #incidents-weekly. Playbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident/playbooks/pcap-capture. Tagged node group: lb-us-west-2-prod-rotary.

deploy-bot: Detected zane/conntrack-hotfix PR. CI green. Canary deploy started by zane. ETA ~ 17m. :rocket:

leo: I'll add a small smoke that exercises random prefixes during debounce rollout to ensure no streaming latency regressions. Will post PR today.

zane: After hotfix I'll run k6 long-tail profile and upload artifacts here.

priya: Opening TLS-fallback PR and contacting CDN partner for cipher mismatch logs. Will paste PR link when ready.

mira: Consolidated action items (I'm maintaining tracker):
- Routing debounce (owner: leo) — due: 2026-04-05
- Conntrack hotfix (owner: zane) — due: 2026-04-03 (hotfix)
- Conntrack capacity test (owner: zane) — due: 2026-04-08
- TLS fallback + canary (owner: priya) — due: 2026-04-04
- Rollout coordination + alerts (owner: mira) — due: 2026-04-06

mira: Please update the tracker when you start work. We'll review status in Monday's retro; reopen this thread if regressions show up. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
